finding: The test does not guarantee concurrent admission. A lone first step can populate legitimate pooled prefix blocks; later admission switches to fused execution. The observed reuse16 is explicitly logged as pooled blocks while the old same-ID retained holder is discarded once. If replacement finishes alone, no new retained holder replaces the old one, so old retained reuse28 is also legitimate. Paired admission through the existing ComputeGate, waiting for StepsHeldByGate before reopening, passes all120 original assertion checks without disabling pooled reuse.
test_only_fix: SequentialRequestIdReuse_DiscardsOldRetainedMetadataAndHolder now parks its worker via existing ComputeGate before opening either paired round. Existing zero-reuse and exactly-one-discard assertions are unchanged.
